privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.lead: Short version: your financial data never leaves your device unless you turn on encrypted sync — and even then, nobody but you can read it.

local.title: Stored on your device
local.body: Accounts, transactions and everything else live in your browser’s IndexedDB. There is no account to create and no login.

noAccount.title: No account, no profile
noAccount.body: Fluxo does not know who you are. There is no email, no password and no user database.

sync.title: Optional end-to-end encrypted sync
sync.body: If you enable sync, your data is encrypted on your device with a key derived from your passphrase before it is uploaded. The passphrase never leaves your device.

server.title: What the server sees
server.body: Only an opaque encrypted blob, its size, a version number and timestamps. It cannot decrypt the contents, and it stores only a hash of your access token.

analytics.title: No tracking
analytics.body: No analytics, no ads, no third-party scripts and no cookies.

control.title: You are in control
control.body: Export a full backup at any time, delete everything from Settings, or delete your sync vault from the server.
